subject: Legacy Girls' College: act on declining results before the next exams
text:
Hello Ms. Grace Yaaba Edziyie,

When a student's results begin to decline, how quickly can your team turn the records into a practical support plan?

subject: Aspire Educational Complex: support before the next report card
text:
Hello Aspire Educational Complex team,

A parent sees a disappointing result and asks: "What is the school doing to help my child improve?"

We are building Veloxa SmartSchool to help your team answer with a clear plan: where the learner needs support, what the teacher is doing, and what the next assessment shows.

The working demo brings together attendance, academic results, fee records and a parent's view. Alongside it, we are developing AI assistance that will help teachers summarise patterns in authorised records and draft focused support plans and progress updates. Teachers review the suggestions and decide what to use.

For example, if a learner's maths results decline, the intended workflow is to review the recorded assessments and attendance, agree on support, and reassess. We will show the current demo and explain the AI work still in development.

Ghana's Ministry of Education and UNICEF's 2025 learning initiative emphasises assessment and practical support for teachers. That direction helped shape our approach: https://www.unicef.org/ghana/press-releases/ghana-accelerates-foundational-learning-ministry-education-unicef-and-hempel

Could I show Aspire Educational Complex the demo on a 15-minute Google Meet? Reply "demo" and I will suggest two times. Interested schools can join our early-access waiting list with no purchase commitment.

John Evans Okyere
Veloxa Technology Ltd. | Veloxa SmartSchool
+233 54 495 4643 / +233 24 554 0271

A parent sees a disappointing result and asks: "What is the school doing to help my child improve?"

We are building Veloxa SmartSchool to help your team answer with a clear plan: where the learner needs support, what the teacher is doing, and what the next assessment shows.

The working demo brings together attendance, academic results, fee records and a parent's view. Alongside it, we are developing AI assistance that will help teachers summarise patterns in authorised records and draft focused support plans and progress updates. Teachers review the suggestions and decide what to use.

For example, if a learner's maths results decline, the intended workflow is to review the recorded assessments and attendance, agree on support, and reassess. We will show the current demo and explain the AI work still in development.

Ghana's Ministry of Education and UNICEF's 2025 learning initiative emphasises assessment and practical support for teachers. That direction helped shape our approach: https://www.unicef.org/ghana/press-releases/ghana-accelerates-foundational-learning-ministry-education-unicef-and-hempel

Hello DORIBABS SCHOOL COMPLEX team,

Hello CAROSSEL KIDS SCHOOL team,

A parent sees a disappointing result and asks: "What is the school doing to help my child improve?"

We are building Veloxa SmartSchool to help your team answer with a clear plan: where the learner needs support, what the teacher is doing, and what the next assessment shows.

The working demo brings together attendance, academic results, fee records and a parent's view. Alongside it, we are developing AI assistance that will help teachers summarise patterns in authorised records and draft focused support plans and progress updates. Teachers review the suggestions and decide what to use.

For example, if a learner's maths results decline, the intended workflow is to review the recorded assessments and attendance, agree on support, and reassess. We will show the current demo and explain the AI work still in development.

Ghana's Ministry of Education and UNICEF's 2025 learning initiative emphasises assessment and practical support for teachers. That direction helped shape our approach: https://www.unicef.org/ghana/press-releases/ghana-accelerates-foundational-learning-ministry-education-unicef-and-hempel

Could I show CAROSSEL KIDS SCHOOL the demo on a 15-minute Google Meet? Reply "demo" and I will suggest two times. Interested schools can join our early-access waiting list with no purchase commitment.

John Evans Okyere
Veloxa Technology Ltd. | Veloxa SmartSchool
+233 54 495 4643 / +233 24 554 0271

If you would prefer no further outreach, reply "no thanks" and I will remove your address.

Hello GOD'S LOVE ACADEMY- BOGOBRI OBUASI team,

A parent sees a disappointing result and asks: "What is the school doing to help my child improve?"

We are building Veloxa SmartSchool to help your team answer with a clear plan: where the learner needs support, what the teacher is doing, and what the next assessment shows.

The working demo brings together attendance, academic results, fee records and a parent's view.
